intent: Preserve bounded application evidence from each inspected exception cause when framework and recovery frames crowd the report budget.
authorization: User requested every implementation fix, green exact-head and main validation, and verified publication.

observed_failure.assertion: Retain ChatRepositoryImpl.preparedCompleteChat:1879 through the actual reporting collector.

preservation_contract: Retain the original collector assertion and first-four leading safe-frame ordering.
Inspect at most four causes and the first 48 frames of each; select at most eight unique safe frames.
Keep the bounded frame grammar, application-only captured bridge, fingerprint projection and approved-byte validation.
Never collect exception messages, filenames or arbitrary stack text; retain the 8192-byte approved payload bound.
Require baseline-negative and corrected actual-source controls, canonical validation and all latest hosted gates before merge.

validation.scope: Only the new crowded recovery/cause retention case fails; cause/frame bounds and all previous controls pass.

validation.check: Fresh corrected actual-source compilation and replay
validation.scope: Actual model, capsule, context, serialization and complete submission; explicit unrelated platform/provider ports. Pure native renderer extracted verbatim. No full Android/device/live dispatch claim. The final test differs from the negative snapshot only by ktlint-required whitespace.
Leading-frame order, per-cause reservation, null/repeated-cause behavior, unchanged grammar/inspection/output/privacy bounds and original collector assertion.

validation.check: Latest exact-head hosted Android and all applicable gates
Exact-main validation and published Android/Gateway readback

solution: Keep the first four leading safe frames, reserve the first safe application frame from each inspected throwable, then fill the same eight-frame budget with existing application and safe-frame order. This prevents a crowded recovery wrapper from consuming every slot before an original cause.
